User review actual 5/sherlock dogfood slice4. Obtain a checked two-result join from StoryModel or a narrow producer comparison packet: exact source identity, target timeline, recall segmentation/unit identity, timing and result provenance must match. Atlas draws only differing decisions with paired anchors joined, on shared axes; supplied decision origins remain separate from posterior mass. Show original alternatives in inspector; content ablation is not reference measurement. Acceptance: frozen full/content NN03 has 39 differing decision records; distinguish target/group/origin difference from the fact all173 posterior rows differ. Refuse mismatched source edition, unit inventory or clocks with a visible reason. No string-label joins, re-normalization or new inference in Atlas. If current producer APIs cannot prove compatibility, file a bounded upstream packet task and leave UI blocked on that exact capability. Integrate with bd-01M35A7BD356ZAYJ5JQ1G7TTTT; participant-comparison bd-01M35A7FPSKEQ8V3AC2H8C30Q4 remains separate.

Reuse the existing Voyage document/compiler/lowering/view; no new frontend or view-side scientific inference. Preserve semantic identities, supplied values, origin shapes, external-dominant hollows, group-level support and existing inspector exact text. Do not add native media boundaries or evidence links without checked producer capabilities. Record exact revision/artifact tuple and run affected Scala gates plus real-browser and synthetic failure witnesses. Existing frozen Sherlock artifacts are regression inputs, not scientific validation. Rollback: disable the new display/control and retain the existing checked Voyage route; never rewrite original artifacts. An actual Intaglio deficiency belongs in ~/code/scala/intaglio with its own Mote ticket and producer-consumer witness. No renderer defect is established by this ticket.
